#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

vector<long long> build_tree(int size) {
    int i = 2;
    while (true) {
        if (i >= size * 2) {
            return vector<long long>(i, 0);
        }
        i *= 2;
    }
}

void set_value(vector<long long>& tree, int len, int i, long long val) {
    int idx = i + len / 2;
    tree[idx] = val;
    idx /= 2;
    while (idx > 0) {
        tree[idx] = tree[2 * idx] + tree[2 * idx + 1];
        idx /= 2;
    }
}

long long sum_range(const vector<long long>& tree, int len, int s, int t) {
    s += len / 2;
    t += len / 2;
    long long total = 0;
    while (s <= t) {
        if (s % 2 == 0) {
            s /= 2;
        } else {
            total += tree[s];
            s = (s + 1) / 2;
        }
        if (t % 2 == 1) {
            total += tree[t];
            t = (t - 1) / 2;
        } else {
            t /= 2;
        }
    }
    return total;
}

vector<long long> prime_factors(long long n) {
    vector<long long> factors;
    for (long long i = 2; i * i <= n; ++i) {
        while (n % i == 0) {
            factors.push_back(i);
            n /= i;
        }
        if (n == 1) break;
    }
    if (n != 1) {
        factors.push_back(n);
    }
    return factors;
}

long long euler_phi(long long n) {
    auto p_factors = prime_factors(n);
    std::set<long long> unique_factors(p_factors.begin(), p_factors.end());
    long long result = n;
    for (auto p : unique_factors) {
        result = result * (p - 1) / p;
    }
    return result;
}

long long factorial_range(long long a, long long b, long long mod) {
    long long res = 1;
    for (long long i = a + 1; i <= b; ++i) {
        res = (res * i) % mod;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    long long mod;
    cin >> n >> mod;
    long long phi_value = euler_phi(mod);
    int max_len = n + 5;
    std::vector<long long> fact(max_len + 1, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= max_len; ++i) {
        fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % mod;
    }

    if (n <= 3) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    std::vector<long long> dp(2000, 0);
    dp[0] = 1; dp[1] = 2; dp[2] = 2; dp[3] = 1;

    auto tree = build_tree(2005);
    int len = (int)tree.size();

    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        set_value(tree, len, i, dp[i]);
    }

    int m = 3;
    long long total = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i <= n - 4; ++i) {
        auto prev_dp = dp;
        long long partial_sum = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j <= i + 2; ++j) {
            for (int k = 1; k <= m + 1; ++k) {
                long long ssum = sum_range(tree, len, j + k + 1, 2004);
                partial_sum = (partial_sum + ssum * prev_dp[k - 1]) % mod;
                dp[j + k] = (dp[j + k] + prev_dp[k - 1]) % mod;
                set_value(tree, len, j + k, dp[j + k]);
            }
        }
        m += i + 3;
        long long factor = factorial_range(i + 4, n, mod);
        total = (total + factor * partial_sum) % mod;
    }

    cout << total % mod << "\n";

    return 0;
}
